relationship: One study within the cooperative personal-agent thesis; not the sole success criterion.

primary_student.deployment: same validated local configuration across primary rounds

acquisition.primary: shared frozen acquisition policy and arrival stream across controls
acquisition.milestone_unit: eligible distinct task arrivals, not successful demonstrations
acquisition.secondary: actual adaptive closed-loop acquisition with selection and cost logging
acquisition.teacher_pool: frozen revisions and inference settings within experiment

training_targets: local investigation, actions, editing, testing and recovery
expert selection, context packaging, request formulation, verification and integration
cadence_controls: restart from original base on accumulated corpus
one-shot final training with matched target-token exposure and compute where feasible

test_policy.sealed_panel: Evaluate all frozen checkpoints once after acquisition and analysis choices are locked; unavailable during learning.
test_policy.monitoring: Fresh prospective panels; any panel used for updates becomes development history.
test_policy.dependence: paired task records and repository-aware uncertainty

local_capability_confirmatory_chain.contrast: standalone S3 minus standalone S0 resolution
adapted routed final system minus H overall resolution
local_capability_confirmatory_chain.H: S*, strongest eligible fixed teacher configuration selected on development model-selection partition
local_capability_confirmatory_chain.margin_status: proposed engineering tolerance; accept before freeze

local_capability_confirmatory_chain.contrast: verified local completion coverage at final adapted condition minus frozen-student/separately-recalibrated-router control

verified_local_coverage.definition: mean over all assigned tasks of mean over three replicates of success * local_only
local_only_excludes: external judging or verification assistance during attempt
verified_local_coverage.strict_offline_execution: separate metric including operational tool dependencies

secondary_required_for_broad_narrative: expert calls, tokens, GPU time and expenditure
device memory, latency, energy where measured, and offline functionality
funding_boundary: US$100 Runpod approval supports bounded integration only, not the full four-round study or additional API charges.
stopping: If final milestone is unfunded or incomplete, do not substitute an earlier favorable round.
quality_claims: No monotonic improvement, universal device fit, achieved frontier or measured democratization claim.
expert_exposure_aggregation: mean within-task replicate fraction with any large-expert assistance; not any-assistance across the three-attempt bundle
confirmatory_scope: Proposed within-Study-2 chain; current program primary is fixed-model Study 1. Separate registration/resources and multiplicity allocation required for additional confirmatory claims.
